Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
>> Can I play a Transfusion after combat then immediatedly restart
>> another combat with Psyche?
>> Could I do the same at the end of that second combat?
>> Could I do the same at the end of the third combat and burn them to
>> take control of them?
> IANLSJ, but;
> Yes, if you only play it at superior once each turn, as per cardtext.
> And you werent blocked with the out/in ferior versions.

Why would you say 'Yes'? You can only put a transfusion counter on a minion
when it is played at superior.
Additionally, Transfusion at nec or thn is not relevant in combat. So to
answer Norm's specific question, it should be 'No' because Transfusion at
THN is limited to once per turn not once per combat.

Sorrow
